text:
Yes. Leafy lists the peace lily as **not pet-safe**, so we recommend keeping it away from your dog. Our policy doesn't go into the specific symptoms or severity.

**If your dog may have chewed or eaten any of the plant**, contact a vet or an animal poison control service right away, before doing anything else.

If you'd like a plant that's safe around pets, these are on our pet-safe list:
- Calathea
- Spider plant
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

You can also get free care advice from a Plant Care Specialist by chat or email, even if you haven't ordered from us.
